name: brindley-sidebar
description: A pane beside the chat showing the repository's Brindley initiatives: counts, what to pick up next, and a detail view that queues work.

order.title: Row order
order.description: How the Pick up next rows are ordered.

exclude.title: Excluded collections
exclude.description: Globs matched against each collection's repo-relative path; matching collections are dropped.

maxRows.title: Rows while collapsed
maxRows.description: How many active rows Pick up next shows while collapsed.

server.title: Brindley MCP server
server.description: The Brindley MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. The default is the brindley plugin's server; set it to the name you registered when Brindley is connected another way (e.g. brindley for claude mcp add brindley).
